metadata.purpose: Open possibly overlapping buffers for each openings value; each selected closing notifier next releases only its own buffer.

conditions: No openings implies no buffers or values; one source item can appear in multiple overlapping buffers.
A closing notifier next emits one array, including an empty array; closing completion does not flush.
Source completion flushes every still-open buffer in opening order, then completes.

scope.parameters: Observable openings and Observable closing streams
scope.callbacks: Selector invocation and return/throw modeled as correlated synchronous microsteps. The pure transition model never executes callbacks.
scope.time: Time and equal-time order come from externally ordered source/openings/closing notifications. No clock or scheduler is introduced.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic post-setup notifications; no reentrant notifications or cancellation inside selector, observers or teardown.
exclusions: Non-Observable ObservableInput conversion (Promises, etc.), arbitrary synchronous/reentrant closing notification during subscription, throwing downstream observers/finalizers.
Cancellation inside selector or between output notification and resource release, callback side effects and arbitrary mutation of previously emitted array references.
Universal symbolic equivalence beyond the finite scoped protocol.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Subscribe to openings first, then source; no buffer exists until an opening value.

ownership.sharing: No sharing or replay; each result subscription owns all buffers and closing subscriptions.
ownership.reset: Fresh buffer identity and selector generation per execution.

dispatch.actionSemantics: Openings next creates a buffer before selector invocation; source appends to all buffers, closing next removes one before emission.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between complete callback/notification reactions; cancel is silent and releases all owned resources.
Selection return/throw are correlated to the pending buffer generation.
